question: Of the 25 families screened as having a builder commit newer than their delivered fixtures/canonical.pdf, which ones' committed artifacts still come from their own build scripts, and where they do not, what actually differs?

changesNothing.note: This lane measures. Every rebuild was made into scratch space or restored byte-for-byte; the committed artifacts are untouched, and so is data/rcap-grade-a/fable-packet-factory/BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY.json, whose 87-row measurement this record deliberately does not overwrite.

method.step1: scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/measure-build-reproducibility.mjs run once per family with --resume, so its 25 rows accumulated rather than each run replacing the last; a row-count guard aborted the sweep if the record ever shrank
method.step2: the 87-row record the tool rewrites was moved aside first and restored from git afterwards, verified at 87 rows with its captainAnswerToTheRicherQuestion annotation intact
method.step3: the seven families the tool could not classify were remeasured by hand with the invocation each builder actually requires, rebuilding into scratch and restoring the family directory
method.step4: divergence was read at appearance level: pdftotext of committed vs rebuilt fixtures, and a field-by-field comparison of reports/actual-writes.json drawnText, not digests alone
method.step5: one central file a builder wrote outside its family directory (data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf13/rows.json, written by build-census-v1-ar-felony-seal-set.mjs) was reverted; the worktree was verified clean afterwards

headlines: 20 of the 25 reproduce their delivered packet PDFs byte for byte. Only 4 do not, and all 4 are Illinois.
No family in this set diverges by a wall-clock stamp. The category the screen anticipated is empty here: every build-status.json that changed changed its raster fields, not a timestamp.

All 14 COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN families in the screen reproduce their packet bytes exactly. None of the four families with wrong delivered bytes is in a proven state; all four already sit in FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED.
il-seal-edu-set is a fourth stale-and-wrong Illinois family, alongside the three on the il-exp-pardon-set host.

deliveredDefects.what: For these four the rebuild changes the delivered packet PDFs, and the delivered bytes carry defects the builder has since repaired. Verified from the committed reports/actual-writes.json and from pdftotext of the committed vs rebuilt fixtures.

il-exp-pardon-set.chargeCellsHoldingTheCaseNumber: 20 of 20 (Request pages 2 and 4) hold 2021-CF-004217; the rebuild writes one charge cell reading "Possession of a controlled substance" and leaves the other nineteen untouched
il-exp-pardon-set.orderItem3Written: no: the delivered EXP-AD Order Granting has 8 writes, all on page 1, and none of Name/Address/Email/Telephone. The rebuild adds all four.
il-exp-pardon-set.caseListColumnMisuse: delivered arrest2..arrest5 carry agency, charge, date and outcome as if they were columns of one row; the rebuild writes arrest1 only
il-exp-pardon-set.truncatedValue: delivered Case List charge cell reads "Charge exactly as shown o…" (a direction to the participant, truncated with an ellipsis)
il-exp-pardon-set.electionsLeftBlank: delivered leaves item 1, item 12 and the 3(b) pardon election unanswered; the rebuild writes Yes/No/Yes

il-exp-precompletion-set.orderItem3Written: no (8 writes, all page 1); rebuild adds all four
il-exp-precompletion-set.electionsLeftBlank: item 1, item 12, item 6 and the 6ab diversion checkbox

il-seal-nonconv-set.orderItem3Written: no (8 writes, all page 1); rebuild adds all four

il-seal-edu-set.chargeCellsHoldingTheCaseNumber: 0 of 1 - this family was carved onto its own builder by FIX04, so it never had the twenty-cell fault
il-seal-edu-set.chargeCellLiteral: the delivered charge cell prints the direction sentence itself: "Charge exactly as shown on the court disposition". The rebuild writes "Possession of a controlled substance".
il-seal-edu-set.orderItem3Written: no; the rebuild adds Name, Address, Email and Telephone
il-seal-edu-set.electionsLeftBlank: item 1, item 12 and the item 22 education route; the rebuild answers all three
il-seal-edu-set.participantInstructions: delivered carries 66 lines of interior AcroForm names as instructions ("Complete arrest60 on EXP-AD Case List page 1"); the rebuild carries none
il-seal-edu-set.note: this family was NOT among the two named as likeliest true positives; it is a fourth.

sourceHashDrift.what: Four families' source-receipt.json records an input at a hash that no longer exists at HEAD. The shared one is the in-repo file data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json, recorded at 6076f734... and now 80b5e071... (last changed by 1784eec3d).
sourceHashDrift.consequence: The delivered receipts name a version of a shared input that has since moved. The packet bytes are unaffected and reproduce exactly. This is stale provenance metadata, not a packet defect, and it is not builder drift.

alsoWithOtherDivergence: ar-felony-seal-set (plus the product-wiring binding written by a different generator)

toolLimitationsFound: determineInvocation misses a builder that runs at top level with no process.argv[1] guard: fl-10yr-bridge-set and il-seal-edu-set were recorded UNKNOWN_INVOCATION but both build on a bare `node <script>`. il-seal-edu-set turned out to be a true positive hiding behind that classification.
A builder that asserts a required flag is recorded UNBUILDABLE: ar-felony-seal-set asserts argv includes --no-raster.

The default 600s build timeout is shorter than four custom-pleading builders' raster stage, which recorded them UNBUILDABLE (ETIMEDOUT): rcap-nd, rcap-ok, rcap-sc and rcap-tn. Three of those four reproduce exactly.

A family whose delivered directory has never had its raster stage run is classified DIVERGES against a rebuild that runs it, even though the packet PDFs are byte-identical. That is 11 of the 16 DIVERGES rows in this sweep.

build-census-v1-ar-felony-seal-set.mjs writes data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf13/rows.json, outside its own family directory. The tool restores such writes; a hand rebuild that restores only the family directory will not.

screenCoverage.what: The screen's stated criterion - every family whose builder has a commit newer than its delivered fixtures/canonical.pdf - matches 64 families in MASTER_QUEUE at this base, not 25 (85 if a shared build host counts as the family's builder). All 25 screened families do satisfy it.
screenCoverage.consequence: Measuring these 25 does not clear the corpus of this shape. At least 39 further families match the same stated criterion and were not measured by this lane.
screenCoverage.alsoNote: data/rcap-grade-a/fable-packet-factory/BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY.json was measured at base 4b1d36fd5 on 2026-09-02, which predates 64f2dbb8e (09-05), d5450b1c8 (09-06) and 32b4cd663 (09-08); its rows for families those commits touched are themselves stale.
